commands.title: Extract a knowledge graph

commands.description: Resolve coreference and merge duplicate entities and relations in a knowledge graph.

commands.description: Detect the community hierarchy of a knowledge graph.

commands.description: Load a knowledge graph document into a graph database backend.

commands.description: Count triangles in the underlying simple undirected graph.
